canonical_title: Anthropic releases Claude Fable 5.1 and Claude Mythos 5.1
treatment: Treat the September 1 release of Claude Fable 5.1 and gated Mythos 5.1 as covered. Reinclude only for material model-card/system-card changes, pricing or availability changes, independent reproducible benchmark/adoption results, safeguard changes, or a major production breakage.
known_facts: Anthropic released Claude Fable 5.1 on September 1, 2026 as its most capable generally available model for coding, knowledge work and long-running agentic tasks.
Claude Mythos 5.1 uses the same underlying model but has reduced safeguards for vetted cybersecurity and life-sciences users through trusted access programs.
Fable 5.1 is available through Claude, the Claude API as claude-fable-5-1, AWS, Google Cloud and Microsoft Foundry.
Base API pricing remains $10 per million input tokens and $50 per million output tokens, while cache reads were cut 75% to $0.25 per million tokens.
Anthropic estimates the cache-price change lowers typical workload cost by about 25% and highly agentic workload cost by up to about 45%.
Fable 5.1 can identify software vulnerabilities in source code, while safeguards still block or reroute exploit development, penetration testing and other higher-risk cyber tasks.
Anthropic says Fable 5.1 improves across coding, scientific research and long-running agent benchmarks; vendor benchmark claims remain subject to independent validation.
reinclude_only_if: Anthropic changes Fable 5.1 or Mythos 5.1 pricing, availability, trusted-access eligibility, safeguards, or model behavior materially.
Anthropic publishes a new system card or technical artifact that materially changes the capability or risk assessment.
A credible independent evaluation demonstrates a material capability, regression, cost or production-adoption result.
A major production incident or compatibility breakage changes practical use.
notes: NEW in the recovered 2026-09-02 Midday run. Public tracking placed the announcement at about 18:27 UTC on September 1, which is 03:27 JST on September 2 and inside the current primary window.
